rootSampling.scope: current execution mutable workspace namespace and its fixed declared mutable evidence streams only while explicitly active; ordinary preparation, writing, drain, pre-seal finalization and publication included; no observation consumer or stage omitted
rootSampling.strict: declared root anchors, prior contexts, controls, retained history, sealed roots, recovery source and every declared quiescent observation
rootSampling.fileLoss: native open ENOENT mapped to FileNotFoundException HRESULT -2147024894; exact mapped FileNotFoundException -2147024894 or DirectoryNotFoundException -2147024893 only for a known enumerated mutable file candidate
rootSampling.branchLoss: DirectoryNotFoundException HRESULT -2147024893 while enumerating a previously enumerated mutable directory branch
rootSampling.unknown: lost branch descendant count, bytes and types are unknown, never zero and never included in the known-file denominator
rootSampling.hard: permission, generic I/O, other native errors, invalid metadata, symbolic or hard links, foreign attribution, process identity loss, missing root anchors, overflow
rootSampling.allLost: sampled-admissible without hard errors or alarms, never complete and never sufficient readiness
rootSampling.population: repeated observation populations, not unique file or inode census

accounting.insertionBounds: file and directory candidates checked before insertion; bounded iterative traversal with partial positive observations and explicit losses; hard errors and descriptors collected independently
accounting.merge: each authoritative record exactly once; source and recovery share 2048 records; campaign aggregates at most 35 bounded entries; no path or metadata history
accounting.complete: no descriptor loss, root loss or hard error
accounting.admissible: explicit revision-7 binding; both known populations accounted, no hard error or alarm; unknown branch population remains unknown
accounting.positiveBytes: dev/inode once across roots and descriptor aliases, maximum positively observed native length; inherited observed-unlinked proof and shared budgets
accounting.unknownBytes: never zero, freed-byte credit or known content

unchanged.allOtherRequirements: eight real probes, 35-case plan, one attempt, durations, providers, sources, rates, gates, 95-percent source floor, RSS, cleanup, exact inventories, publication, reopen, hashes, decision rule

readiness: inherited revision-6 clean committed source and exact executing binary provenance; fresh schema/hash-bound receipts, source/binaries/environment/host/fixture, all eight actual sealed reviewed coverages; decision rechecks readiness and labels unified-active-policy/1-conditional-no-product-decision
storageClaim: non-atomic observed maxima with explicit unknown root and descriptor losses; no instantaneous aggregate storage bound
legacy: all frozen inputs, maps, goldens, historical attempts and inspection remain unchanged; old hard root failures never upgraded
